question: _______ is the largest union territory in India in terms of area.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ladakh.**__

__
 
• **Largest Union Territory: Ladakh**
 
• India is a federal union comprising 28 states and 8 union territories, for a total of 36 entities.
 
• The area of J&K is **42,241** ** km²****,** whereas the area of Ladakh is 59,146 km².

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9074044cf96dc1d09ca89eac99180c3d7440ade1b364d09d47931959bf693cc8.png] **Confusion Points__**

 
• Don't be confused by maps, maps are just projections of the ground and things might look bigger or smaller in real life. 
 
• **These are based on the projection system adopted.**
